Types

Bathroom basins: above counter, inset, undermount and wall hung

The basin type decides how the bench is cut and where the tap goes, so choose it before the top is made. Above counter basins are the largest group on this page, in round, square, rectangular and fluted shapes.

Which basin type suits which bench or wall?

Basin typeHow it sitsSuitsOn this page
Above counterThe whole bowl sits on top of the benchStone and timber tops, and making a feature of the basin155 basins
InsetDrops into a cut-out, with the rim resting on the benchLaminate and stone tops where you want a lower bowl15 basins
Semi recessedThe back sits in the bench and the front projects past itShallow benches and narrow rooms9 basins
UndermountFixed under the bench, so the top runs to the edge of the bowlStone tops, where the bench can be wiped straight into the bowl12 basins
Wall hungFixed to the wall with no cabinet belowPowder rooms and small ensuites12 basins

Counts are read from the product names and descriptions on this page. Some basins can be fitted more than one way.

Pricing

Basin pricing

The basins on this page show Enquire Now. Add the ones you are considering to your enquiry and the team confirms the price of each, along with the waste and the mixer to suit.

Size, shape and finish all affect the price. A matte or coloured finish usually costs more than gloss white in the same shape.

Matching

Matching a basin to a vanity or benchtop

Check three things against the top: the depth of the bench, the position of the tap hole and the size of the cut-out. An above counter basin needs only a waste hole. An inset or undermount basin needs a cut-out made to its template.

If you are still choosing the cabinet, look at a new vanity and its matching tops first, then pick the basin to suit. Some basins here are made to suit pre cut stone tops.

Materials

Ceramic and stone basin materials

Most basins on this page are fine ceramic: 135 of the 217 are described that way by the maker. Ceramic is fired with a glazed surface, so it does not absorb water and is easy to wipe clean.

A small number are quartz basins or stone tops supplied with an undermount basin. Stone and quartz have a matte, solid feel and need a non-abrasive cleaner.

Availability

Availability and order times

Tell us the product code, the colour and whether you need the tap hole or no tap hole version. The team confirms what can be supplied and how long it will take.

If the stone top is being cut to suit, have the basin on site first so the stonemason can work from the real thing.

Mixers

Choosing a basin with the right mixer

The mixer has to reach over the rim and into the bowl. An above counter basin needs a tall basin mixer on the bench or a wall mounted mixer and spout. An inset or undermount basin takes a standard height mixer.

Check whether the basin has a tap hole or none. See the basin mixer range and choose both together.

Warranty

Basin warranty

Basins carry their maker's warranty. It covers faults in the ceramic or glaze, and it depends on the basin being installed correctly and not being chipped by impact.

Ask us for the warranty terms of the basin you choose before you buy.

Getting it

Pick-up and delivery

Collect from the Bonnyrigg showroom, or ask about delivery across Sydney metro with the rest of your order. If you need a bathroom basin in Sydney quickly for a booked plumber, call (02) 8786 0288 and the team will check what can be supplied.

Basins are part of the full range: we deliver bathroom supplies Sydney metro wide.

The range

Poseidon basins

All 217 basins on this page come from the Poseidon and KDK Home range. Product names carry the maker's code and, in most cases, the size in millimetres, so you can match a basin to a drawing or a plumber's note.

Shapes include round, square, rectangular and oval bowls, with fluted designs in the VITO and Cascade series.

Care

Keeping a basin clean

Rinse the basin after use and wipe it with a soft cloth. Clean it weekly with a mild bathroom cleaner. Avoid scourers and abrasive powders, which scratch the glaze and mark matte finishes.

Toothpaste, hair dye and make-up stain matte surfaces if they are left to dry, so wipe them off straight away.

Basins

Basin questions

What is the difference between an inset and undermount basin?

An inset basin drops into the bench from above and its rim sits on the surface. An undermount basin is fixed underneath, so the benchtop runs to the edge of the bowl and you can wipe water straight in.

What size basin suits a small bathroom?

Look for a compact above counter or wall hung basin. Basins on this page start at about 300 mm across, and the wall hung basins need no cabinet. Measure the bench depth and the door swing before you choose.

Do basins come with a waste?

Usually not. 89 basins on this page state that the plug and waste are not included, and 149 list a 32 mm waste outlet. Check the description of the basin you choose and order the waste with it.

How much is a bathroom basin?

Basin prices at Bonnyrigg Tiles are confirmed on enquiry. Add the basin to your enquiry and the team will give you the price for the size and finish you want.

Which mixer suits an above counter basin?

A tall basin mixer mounted on the bench, or a wall mounted mixer and spout. A standard height mixer will not clear the rim of most above counter basins.

Are ceramic basins durable?

Yes. Fine ceramic is hard, glazed and does not absorb water, so it handles daily use well. It can chip or crack if something heavy is dropped on it.
